home.title: Home
home.summary: See the fleet snapshot, recent activity, and items that may need operator attention.
steps: Review Needs you for pending approvals and review tasks.
Open Fleet or Activity to inspect a count in context.

troubleshooting.symptom: A count is zero or missing
troubleshooting.action: Open the related screen and check whether its data is available for the selected period.

agents.title: Fleet
agents.summary: Browse registered agents and their reported presence.
steps: Select an agent to open identity, activity, and configuration details.
Use the agent detail tabs to find tasks, tools, knowledge, or messages.

troubleshooting.action: Register an agent with the documented Arc team workflow, then reload the screen.

agents/:id.title: Agent detail
agents/:id.summary: Inspect one agent across its identity, configuration, activity, and capability tabs.
steps: Choose a tab to focus the information you need.
Use controls on a tab only when you are authorized for that operation.

fields.label: Identity instructions
fields.description: Review the agent identity document. Editing changes the document used to describe this agent; keep instructions accurate and authorized.

fields.label: Identity document
fields.description: Text content of identity.md. Review the complete text before saving.

fields.label: Detail tab
fields.description: Select the agent area to inspect; available tabs depend on this agent.

fields.label: Overview tab
fields.description: Summary of this agent’s identity, current performance, recent sessions, tasks, and schedules.

fields.label: Identity tab
fields.description: Inspect the agent DID, identity configuration, tool policy, and workspace identity details.

fields.label: Inbox tab
fields.description: Search and review this agent’s inbox threads; reply or hand off a thread when authorized.

fields.label: Sessions tab
fields.description: Review recorded sessions for this agent.

fields.label: Runs tab
fields.description: Review recent runs and spawn lineage for this agent.

fields.label: Model usage tab
fields.description: Inspect model activity recorded for this agent.

fields.label: Skills tab
fields.description: Review skills available to this agent.

fields.label: Tools tab
fields.description: Review tools registered and available to this agent.

fields.label: Prompts tab
fields.description: Inspect prompts associated with this agent.

fields.label: Knowledge tab
fields.description: Inspect this agent’s memories, entities, events, and indexed knowledge.

fields.label: Tasks tab
fields.description: Review tasks owned by this agent; use the tag filter to narrow the list.

fields.label: Schedules tab
fields.description: Review scheduled tasks for this agent.

fields.label: Policy tab
fields.description: Review policy bullets associated with this agent.

fields.label: Trust tab
fields.description: Review approvals and capabilities awaiting trust decisions.

fields.label: Workspace tab
fields.description: Browse this agent’s workspace files.

fields.label: Files tab
fields.description: Browse files visible in this agent’s file view.

fields.label: Connect tab
fields.description: Configure the supported messaging connection and agent voice controls shown here.

fields.label: Search agent mail
fields.description: Filter this agent’s inbox threads by matching text.

fields.label: Reply to mail thread
fields.description: Write a reply to the selected thread as the signed operator.

fields.label: Handoff recipient
fields.description: Choose the participant to receive the selected thread handoff.

fields.label: Telegram bot token
fields.description: Enter the bot token used for this agent’s Telegram connection. Treat it as a secret.

fields.label: Telegram chat ID
fields.description: Enter the Telegram chat identifier associated with this agent.

fields.label: Voice blend
fields.description: Enter the voice preset blend using the displayed name:weight format.

fields.label: Voice speed
fields.description: Enter the playback speed multiplier.

troubleshooting.action: Return to Fleet and confirm the agent is registered and its status is current.
Check the displayed reason and operator authorization; review Audit for the recorded action.

messages.title: Chat
messages.summary: Send direct messages to agents and follow team channels.
steps: Select an agent or channel.
Wait for the composer to show it is ready, then send your message.
Use Activity to confirm whether a message produced a run.

fields.label: Conversation
fields.description: Choose the agent or channel whose messages you want to view.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Text to send to the selected conversation. Avoid placing credentials or sensitive secrets in chat.
fields.example: Please summarize the latest deployment status.

troubleshooting.action: Wait for the connection to recover, then retry.
Check whether messaging delivered the request and review Activity.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.summary: Track work across the fleet and inspect each task’s owner, status, and review state.
steps: Use owner or tag filters to narrow the board.
Open a task to inspect details or available actions.
Use Operator controls and New task to create work.

fields.label: Owner filter
fields.description: Show tasks for one owner or all owners.

fields.label: Tag filter
fields.description: Show tasks matching a tag or all tags.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short, actionable description of the work.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional context and completion details.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Set the task’s relative urgency.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Choose an agent to place the task in its to-do; leave unassigned for the fleet backlog.

fields.label: Require review
fields.description: When enabled, completion enters review for operator approval.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Move the task to one of the available workflow states.

fields.label: Message owner
fields.description: Send a message about this task to its owner.

troubleshooting.action: Confirm operator authorization and inspect the displayed error.
Clear owner and tag filters, then check whether tasks have been created.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.summary: Review actions that are waiting for human sign-off.
steps: Read the displayed requester, requested tool, arguments, and gate reason.
Choose Approve or Deny only after reviewing the request; this screen does not collect a separate decision reason.

fields.label: Approval request
fields.description: Review the displayed requester, tool, arguments, policy gate, and reason before choosing Approve or Deny.

troubleshooting.action: There are no pending requests currently listed; this does not change policy permissions.
Read the reason and inspect Audit; do not bypass policy.

gated.title: Pending capabilities
gated.summary: Inspect tools and skills held back by signing or policy checks.
steps: Review the capability, signer, and current state.
For a locked approval, use Review source and wait for the displayed source to match.
Approve or disapprove only after verifying the artifact.

fields.label: Show all capabilities
fields.description: Include capabilities that already load, for operator signing review.

fields.label: Capability
fields.description: Select an item to inspect its signature and source review state.

troubleshooting.action: Complete Review source and verify it matches the capability before approval.
Review its signature and policy status; never disable verification.

policy.title: Rules
policy.summary: Review fleet ACE policy bullets and their scores and lifecycle state.
steps: Search or sort to locate a rule.
Open the rule and inspect related events in Audit if its effect is unexpected.

fields.label: Search rules
fields.description: Filter policy bullets by matching text.

fields.label: Sort rules
fields.description: Order bullets by score, use count, or creation time.

fields.label: Include retired
fields.description: Toggle whether retired bullets appear in the list.

troubleshooting.action: Check search text and whether retired rules are included.

security.title: Audit
security.summary: Inspect the ordered audit record of control actions and policy decisions.
steps: Select an event to see its actor, target, reason, time, and integrity data.
Preserve event time and non-sensitive details when escalating a missing record.

fields.label: Audit event
fields.description: Select an event row to inspect its recorded details.

troubleshooting.action: Record the time and action, then contact the system operator; do not alter audit data.
Preserve the displayed error and escalate to the system operator.

arcrun.title: Activity
arcrun.summary: Inspect recorded agent runs and their action traces.
steps: Search for a run, then select it to inspect its steps.
Compare a run with the related chat or task when investigating a missing response.

fields.label: Search runs
fields.description: Filter recorded runs using identifying text shown in the list.

fields.label: Run
fields.description: Select a run to inspect its events and tool steps.

troubleshooting.action: Clear the search and check the relevant time range or request delivery.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.summary: Browse workflow drafts and configured workflows.
steps: Open a workflow to inspect its graph, trigger, and response target.
Use Show archived to include archived entries.
Create a draft, then configure and review it before use.

fields.label: Workflow name
fields.description: Name the new draft so operators can identify it.

fields.label: Archived workflows
fields.description: Toggle visibility of archived workflows.

troubleshooting.action: Check archived visibility and whether the workflow exists in this environment.

workflows/:id.title: Workflow detail
workflows/:id.summary: Review and edit a workflow graph, trigger, and response target.
steps: Inspect nodes and connections before saving changes.
Choose a trigger and response target that match the intended workflow.
Review the workflow status after saving.

fields.label: Workflow name
fields.description: Human-readable name shown in the workflow list.

fields.label: Node ID
fields.description: Stable identifier used to refer to this node within the workflow.

fields.label: Node type
fields.description: Choose the node behavior from the available types.

fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Instructions provided to this workflow node.

fields.label: Input mapping
fields.description: JSON input mapping; values can reference workflow inputs or previous node output.

fields.label: Script reference
fields.description: Configured script value for node types that support it.

fields.label: Gate
fields.description: Gate identifier used for a gated step.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Expression controlling a conditional edge; reference node outputs as shown in the editor.

fields.label: Output schema
fields.description: Expected output schema for this node.

fields.label: Artifacts
fields.description: Artifact references associated with the node.

fields.label: Loop back to
fields.description: Target node for a loop-back edge.

fields.label: Starts
fields.description: Choose manual, scheduled cron, or interval triggering.

fields.label: Cron expression
fields.description: Five-part minute, hour, day, month, weekday schedule.

fields.label: Every (seconds)
fields.description: Interval between scheduled starts, in seconds.

fields.label: Not before
fields.description: Earliest local time the scheduled workflow may run.

fields.label: Not after
fields.description: Latest local time the scheduled workflow may run.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.description: Timezone used for schedule windows.

fields.label: Response target
fields.description: Channel that receives the workflow response; None leaves it unset.

troubleshooting.action: Check trigger values and displayed workflow status, then compare with Activity.
Review the displayed validation or version conflict and reload current workflow state.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.summary: Inspect one agent’s memories, entities, insights, and connected-source indexing.
steps: Select an agent, then choose the relevant knowledge tab.
In Connections, choose a source and review its status and available resources.
Select the desired scope, save it, and submit any required mapping approval before syncing.

fields.label: Agent
fields.description: Choose whose knowledge store to inspect.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Choose a connected source for status, resources, and sync operations.

fields.label: Filter documents
fields.description: Narrow the displayed indexed documents.

fields.label: Search chunks
fields.description: Find indexed text within the selected connection.

fields.label: Table
fields.description: Name a datastore table for the displayed lookup.

fields.label: Operation
fields.description: Choose get record, find, or list for the lookup.

fields.label: Primary key value
fields.description: Record key for a get-record lookup.

fields.label: Column
fields.description: Column used to filter a find lookup.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: Value matched against the selected column.

fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of results to request.

fields.label: Canonical item ID
fields.description: Find provenance for one canonical knowledge item.

fields.label: Mapping status
fields.description: Filter mapping profiles by review state.

troubleshooting.action: Confirm the account is connected and granted to this agent; source discovery may also be unavailable.
Check whether Knowledge sync is installed and whether the source is paused or degraded.

shared-knowledge.title: Shared knowledge
shared-knowledge.summary: Search knowledge that agents have promoted for fleet sharing.
steps: Search for a known phrase.
Open the result owner’s Knowledge screen to investigate its source.

fields.label: Search shared knowledge
fields.description: Search the shared knowledge currently visible to the fleet.

troubleshooting.action: Try a distinctive phrase and inspect the owning agent’s Knowledge view.

arcllm.title: Model usage
arcllm.summary: Review recorded model request, token, latency, and cost summaries.
steps: Choose the displayed time period and compare metrics by provider or agent.
Use Activity to investigate an individual run.

fields.label: Time window
fields.description: Select the period summarized by the charts.

troubleshooting.action: Check the time window and compare with Activity; telemetry may be unavailable.

tools-skills.title: Tools & Skills
tools-skills.summary: Review capability inventory and availability by agent.
steps: Filter the inventory by agent, type, or source.
For an import, select the target agent and upload a signed capability ZIP.
Review staged files before promotion or signing.

fields.label: Agent filter
fields.description: Limit the inventory to capabilities associated with one agent.

fields.label: Import for agent
fields.description: Choose the agent that will receive the staged capability.

fields.label: Capability ZIP
fields.description: Select a signed ZIP archive to stage for review.

fields.label: Staged file
fields.description: Choose a staged file to inspect or edit before promotion.

fields.label: File content
fields.description: Review or edit the selected staged file; changes are part of the staged import.

troubleshooting.action: Review staged files and the signature or policy status in Pending capabilities.
Use the staged import review journey for a replacement.

connections.title: Connections
connections.summary: Manage connected accounts, which agents can use them, and available connection checks.
steps: Choose an available bundle and complete its connection flow.
Grant access only to agents that need the connection.
For indexable sources, open configure and sync to choose resources and approve mappings.

fields.label: Connector bundle
fields.description: Choose the installed connector to configure.

fields.label: Agent access
fields.description: Grant or remove this account’s access for an agent. An agent granted several Google accounts gets one set of Google tools and picks the account per call; it can never reach an account it was not granted.

fields.label: Authorization code
fields.description: Enter the code returned by the provider authorization step.

fields.label: Access token
fields.description: Enter the provider token required by this connector; it is masked in the UI.

fields.label: Google sign-in
fields.description: Opens Google in a new tab so you can let Arc read this account. Sign in as the account shown and click Allow. The link works for a few minutes; if it runs out, click the button again.

fields.label: Address from the browser bar
fields.description: After you click Allow, Google sends you to a page that does not load. That is expected. Copy the full address from the top of the browser and paste it here. It holds a one-time code that finishes the sign-in.

fields.label: Google account
fields.description: The email address this connection reads. Each Google account is its own connection, so add one connection per address.

fields.label: OAuth client
fields.description: The name of your own published Google OAuth client, as stored on this computer. With a published client, Google stops making you sign in again every week. Leaving it blank uses the built-in client, whose sign-ins expire in about 7 days.

fields.label: Access
fields.description: Read only is recommended: the agent can read mail, calendar and Drive, and every draft, label, trash or send tool refuses with a clear message. Choose full access only if the agent must draft, organise or send mail. After you change this, reconnect so Google asks again.

fields.label: Account name
fields.description: Label the connected account so operators can distinguish it.

fields.label: Connector credential
fields.description: Enter the credential required by this connector. It is not displayed after saving.

fields.label: Service endpoint
fields.description: Enter the endpoint URL when the connector requests one.

fields.label: Connection check
fields.description: Use Doctor for diagnostics or Probe to check live reachability. Use Approve after an update changes the connector’s tools: until then, changed tools stay switched off for this connection.

troubleshooting.action: Install a connector bundle in the configured extension path.
Review the displayed diagnostic and provider access; use re-auth when available.
Confirm the connector supports indexing and the account is granted to this agent.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: View or edit system-wide and agent-specific configuration.
steps: Choose System or an agent scope.
Open the relevant configuration tab and review each value before editing.
Provider key controls report presence without showing saved credentials.

fields.label: Configuration scope
fields.description: Choose fleet-wide System settings or one agent; agent values layer over system defaults.

fields.label: Configuration value
fields.description: Field names and accepted types are defined by the selected configuration schema. Review the field description and validation before changing it.

fields.label: Provider key
fields.description: Enter a provider credential only in its designated masked key control; saved values are never shown back.

fields.label: Maximum turns
fields.description: Hard ceiling on agentic loop turns. A higher ceiling can increase run time and model usage.

fields.label: Tool timeout
fields.description: Maximum time a tool call may run before timing out. Use a value suited to the tool; longer limits can hold resources longer.

fields.label: Models & providers
fields.description: Configuration for model defaults, providers, and model-call modules. A change can affect which models agents call and how calls are routed.

fields.label: Work loop
fields.description: Configuration for run limits, timeouts, retries, and strategy availability. Changes can affect run duration and resource use.

fields.label: Agent behavior
fields.description: Configuration for agent tools, skills, memory, and modules. Review the module-specific schema before changing values.

fields.label: Chat surfaces
fields.description: Configuration for chat channels and who may use them. Review access effects before saving.

fields.label: Extension-defined setting
fields.description: ArcUI has no description for this extension-defined key. Consult the installed extension’s own configuration documentation before changing it.

fields.label: Agent name
fields.description: Identifier shown for this agent in roster and logs.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: Organization label associated with this agent.

fields.label: Agent type
fields.description: Role/type label used by agent configuration and roster consumers.

fields.label: Workspace path
fields.description: Directory used as this agent’s workspace; changing it changes where workspace state and files are resolved.

fields.label: Default model
fields.description: Provider/model identifier used for this agent’s model calls unless a route selects another allowed model.

fields.label: Generation token limit
fields.description: Optional per-agent generation token limit; when unset, the shared model configuration supplies the limit.

fields.label: Model temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature sent with model requests; provider/model support may constrain its effect.

fields.label: Run token ceiling
fields.description: Optional per-run token ceiling. Unset means this budget dimension is uncapped; stricter deployment tiers may enforce a floor.

fields.label: Run cost ceiling
fields.description: Optional per-run model cost ceiling in US dollars. Unset means this budget dimension is uncapped; stricter deployment tiers may enforce a floor.

fields.label: Run request ceiling
fields.description: Optional per-run model request ceiling. Unset means this budget dimension is uncapped; stricter deployment tiers may enforce a floor.

fields.label: Display name
fields.description: Friendly name shown in ArcUI fleet surfaces; this is presentation metadata, not the agent identity.

fields.label: Role label
fields.description: Short role text shown alongside the agent in ArcUI.

fields.label: Display color
fields.description: Color hint used by ArcUI for this agent; it does not change agent behavior.

fields.label: Hide from fleet view
fields.description: When enabled, ArcUI omits this agent from the fleet roster display.

fields.label: Agent DID
fields.description: Decentralized identifier bound to this agent; change only as part of the identity provisioning procedure.

fields.label: Agent key directory
fields.description: Location used to resolve this agent’s identity keys. Keep private key material under the approved key-custody workflow.

fields.label: Identity vault reference
fields.description: Vault reference used when resolving this agent’s identity credential.

fields.label: Vault backend
fields.description: Selects the configured vault integration used for credential resolution.

fields.label: Vault cache lifetime
fields.description: How long resolved vault values may remain cached, in seconds.

fields.label: Tool timeout
fields.description: Maximum wall-clock duration for an individual tool dispatch, in seconds; accepted range is 1–600.

fields.label: Tool instructions
fields.description: Additional text provided with the configured tool set. Keep policy and secrets out of this user-editable text.

fields.label: Operate in launch directory
fields.description: When enabled, supported file/exec tools use the launch directory only when it is already within the workspace and allowed paths.

fields.label: Approval timeout
fields.description: How long a human approval request may wait before timing out, in seconds.

fields.label: Telemetry enabled
fields.description: Enables or disables ArcAgent telemetry collection.

fields.label: Telemetry service name
fields.description: Service label attached to exported telemetry.

fields.label: Log level
fields.description: Minimum severity written by the configured logging pipeline.

fields.label: Export traces
fields.description: When enabled, sends traces to the configured telemetry exporter.

fields.label: Telemetry endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint used by the configured trace exporter.

fields.label: Capture tool input and output
fields.description: Controls whether raw tool arguments/results are persisted for run inspection. Defaults vary by security tier; raw content may be sensitive.

fields.label: Context token target
fields.description: Token capacity used by context management when estimating the model context window.

fields.label: Prune threshold
fields.description: Context-use fraction at which older context is pruned.

fields.label: Compaction threshold
fields.description: Context-use fraction at which the session compaction summary is triggered.

fields.label: Emergency threshold
fields.description: Context-use fraction for emergency context reduction.

fields.label: Token estimate multiplier
fields.description: Adjustment applied to estimated token use to account for estimation uncertainty.

fields.label: Evaluation provider
fields.description: Provider used for background evaluation calls; empty uses the agent’s configured provider.

fields.label: Evaluation model
fields.description: Model used for background evaluation; empty uses the agent’s configured model.

fields.label: Evaluation output limit
fields.description: Maximum generated tokens for one evaluation request.

fields.label: Evaluation input limit
fields.description: Approximate input-token budget for one evaluation request; oversized input is split. Zero disables this limit.

fields.label: Evaluation temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature for evaluation and summarization calls.

fields.label: Evaluation timeout
fields.description: Maximum duration for one evaluation request, in seconds.

fields.label: Evaluation fallback
fields.description: Choose whether an unavailable evaluation step is skipped or causes an error.

fields.label: Evaluation concurrency
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous evaluation calls.

fields.label: Background queue size
fields.description: Maximum queued background jobs per module.

fields.label: Background task timeout
fields.description: Maximum duration for a background task, in seconds.

fields.label: Session retention count
fields.description: Number of recent sessions to retain.

fields.label: Session retention days
fields.description: Age window used to retain sessions.

fields.label: Compaction summary length
fields.description: Maximum characters retained in a session compaction summary.

fields.label: Compaction timeout
fields.description: Maximum time allowed for the post-turn compaction model call; on timeout the compaction is skipped.

fields.label: Team root
fields.description: Directory containing this agent’s team/fleet coordination data.

fields.label: Enable child-agent spawning
fields.description: Registers the spawn_task tool so the model can request child runs.

fields.label: Spawn depth limit
fields.description: Maximum nested child-run depth.

fields.label: Concurrent child runs
fields.description: Maximum number of child runs allowed at once.

fields.label: Child run turn limit
fields.description: Hard maximum turns for each spawned child run.

fields.label: Child run timeout
fields.description: Wall-clock limit for each child run, in seconds.

fields.label: Child token pool
fields.description: Optional shared token budget across child runs; unset leaves this pool uncapped.

fields.label: Security tier
fields.description: Deployment tier that sets credential, executor, and policy stringency. Federal floors cannot be relaxed in configuration.

fields.label: Agent clearance
fields.description: Maximum data classification this agent may handle under classification-aware policy.

fields.label: Enforce classification checks
fields.description: When enabled, policy refuses operations without sufficient classification context.

fields.label: Repeated-call circuit breaker
fields.description: Optional threshold for identical repeated tool calls before the run is stopped.

fields.label: Tool-error circuit breaker
fields.description: Optional threshold for consecutive tool failures before the run is stopped.

fields.label: Parallel tool-call limit
fields.description: Maximum number of tool calls the loop may run concurrently; federal tier can impose a stricter floor.

fields.label: Policy audit chain path
fields.description: Path for the signed policy-decision audit chain; a relative path is resolved within the workspace.

fields.label: Operator key directory
fields.description: Directory used to resolve the operator signing authority. Keep outside the agent workspace and follow the managed key-custody process.

fields.label: Operator key vault reference
fields.description: Vault reference for resolving the operator signing key when vault custody is configured.

fields.label: Audit signing algorithm
fields.description: Signing algorithm for operator policy-chain records; federal tier requires its FIPS-approved setting.

fields.label: Operator key custody
fields.description: Selects in-process key use or reference-based vault signing; enterprise/federal tier may require vault custody.

fields.label: Notary keystore path
fields.description: Keystore location used by the vault-transit development/CI notary backend.

fields.label: Require FIPS cryptography
fields.description: When enabled, startup requires a FIPS-validated backend and approved algorithm.

fields.label: Witness medium path
fields.description: Append-only location for witness checkpoint heads; federal deployment requires it to be separate from operator key custody.

fields.label: Witness mode
fields.description: Choose offline append-only witness storage or the configured transparency-log backend.

fields.label: Transparency log endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint used when witness mode is transparency_log.

fields.label: Allow all workspace-tool imports
fields.description: Relaxes import restrictions at enterprise tier; ignored at federal and not needed at personal tier.

fields.label: Execution isolation
fields.description: Controls the personal-tier execution isolation relaxation for signed and approved workspace-authored tools. Higher tiers reject weakening the container floor.

fields.label: Tools requiring approval
fields.description: Tool names that require human approval at personal/enterprise tier even when other policy would allow them.

fields.label: Sandbox tool allowlist
fields.description: Restricts the loop to these tool names; an empty/unset value permits registered tools.

fields.label: Gateway security tier
fields.description: Sets credential-resolution stringency for gateway platform credentials.

fields.label: Default gateway agent
fields.description: Agent DID that receives gateway messages unless a platform overrides it.

fields.label: Gateway runtime directory
fields.description: Directory used for gateway runtime state.

fields.label: Require user pairing
fields.description: Requires a direct-message user to complete pairing before gateway routing.

fields.label: Enable web chat
fields.description: Enables the in-process browser chat platform.

fields.label: Web chat agent
fields.description: Agent DID serving web chat; empty inherits the gateway default.

fields.label: Web connection limit
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous browser connections; valid range is 1–10000.

fields.label: Web idle timeout
fields.description: Seconds before an idle browser connection expires; valid range is 60–86400.

fields.label: Web frame limit
fields.description: Maximum browser message frame size in bytes; valid range is 1024–1048576.

fields.label: Pairing database path
fields.description: Location of the gateway pairing database.

fields.label: Default provider
fields.description: Provider selected when a model request does not specify another provider.

fields.label: Default temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature used by the global model defaults.

fields.label: Default output token limit
fields.description: Maximum generated tokens supplied by the global model defaults.

fields.label: Vault backend
fields.description: Selects the vault integration used to resolve configured credentials.

fields.label: Vault cache lifetime
fields.description: How long resolved vault values may remain cached, in seconds.

fields.label: Vault endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint for the configured vault service.

fields.label: Vault region
fields.description: Region passed to the configured vault backend.

fields.label: Entity Id
fields.description: Stable identifier for this agent in team messaging.

fields.label: Entity Name
fields.description: Display name used in team messaging.

fields.label: Nats Url
fields.description: NATS connection URL for team messaging; treat credential-bearing URLs as secrets.

fields.label: Auto Ack
fields.description: Acknowledge a message automatically after delivery processing.

fields.label: Max Messages Per Poll
fields.description: Maximum messages inspected in one inbox poll.

fields.label: Roster Ttl Seconds
fields.description: How long the team roster may be reused before refresh, in seconds.

fields.label: Entity Role
fields.description: Role label published for this messaging entity.

fields.label: Channel Route
fields.description: Allow the routing layer to direct channel messages to this agent.

fields.label: Route Top K
fields.description: Maximum candidate agents considered by message routing.

fields.label: Route Ambiguity Margin
fields.description: Score margin required to choose a routed agent without ambiguity.

fields.label: Route Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum duration of one message-routing decision, in seconds.

fields.label: Route Failure Threshold
fields.description: Consecutive routing failures before the route circuit breaker opens.

fields.label: Route Base Wait Seconds
fields.description: Base delay used before retrying a failed route.

fields.label: Route Embed Backend
fields.description: Embedding backend used to match messages to agents.

fields.label: Route Embed Model
fields.description: Embedding model used by message routing.

fields.label: Route Embed Base Url
fields.description: Service endpoint for the configured routing embedder.

fields.label: Sweep Enabled
fields.description: Enable periodic review of unanswered messages.

fields.label: Sweep After Seconds
fields.description: Minimum age before an unanswered message is considered for follow-up.

fields.label: Sweep Max Per Tick
fields.description: Maximum unanswered messages checked in one sweep.

fields.label: Channel Answer Cap
fields.description: Maximum number of agents allowed to answer one channel message.
